node.label: Industry & PLI schemes
node.summary: Manufacturing policy and Production Linked Incentive schemes.

facts.text: Pune-based electric CV maker **EKA Mobility** (founder chairman **Sudhir Mehta**; Pinnacle Industries subsidiary) opened six plants in Maharashtra and M.P. (capacity **40,000** vehicles) and plans **₹1,000 crore** of R&D; order book of **11,000 e-buses** worth $1.7 bn.
facts.plain: Pune-based electric CV maker EKA Mobility (founder chairman Sudhir Mehta; Pinnacle Industries subsidiary) opened six plants in Maharashtra and M.P. (capacity 40,000 vehicles) and plans ₹1,000 crore of R&D; order book of 11,000 e-buses worth $1.7 bn.

facts.text: The PLI scheme for textiles was approved in **Sept 2021** with an outlay of **₹10,683 crore**; PLI schemes cover 14 sectors.
facts.plain: The PLI scheme for textiles was approved in Sept 2021 with an outlay of ₹10,683 crore; PLI schemes cover 14 sectors.

facts.text: Textiles Ministry reopens the **PLI scheme for textiles** portal (round 4) from **1 Nov to 31 Dec**, focused on **man-made fibre (MMF)** apparel, MMF fabrics and **technical textiles**.
